verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no observe or plan primitive that returns candidate actions for the current page before the agent acts. The documented features are event polling during a run, live view for human control, and prompting a run to stop at a screen. These are adjacent monitoring or human-checkpoint features, not action previews.

support.subject: As a developer, I can preview candidate actions on the current page (observe/plan) before committing the agent to act
